indicator.subject: Science
indicator.content_standard: B1.4.3.2: Recognise some simple machines used for making work easier, analyse their advantages and know their uses. E.g. levers, inclined planes and pulleys (Document prints '1.4.3.2.' — missing 'B')
indicator.objective: Understand what simple machines are and cite common examples

skills.description: Understand that simple machines are tools that help make work easier and faster
Identify common simple machines used in the home, school, or community
Match a simple machine to the task it makes easier
Describe simple safe practices when using a simple machine
Draw a simple machine and label it

misconceptions: A simple machine is a big engine or a car.
Scissors are just for cutting paper, not a machine.
A broom is not a machine.
Machines work on their own without a person or force.

questions.stem: What is a simple machine?
options: A tool that makes work easier
questions.explanation: A simple machine is a tool that makes work easier and faster.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think a machine must be big and use electricity.

questions.stem: Which of these is a simple machine?
questions.explanation: Scissors are a simple machine used for cutting.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think scissors are just a tool, not a machine.

questions.stem: What do we use a bottle opener for?
hints: It removes the cap from a bottle.
You use it in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: A bottle opener is a simple machine used to open bottles.
questions.misconception: Pupils may confuse the opener with a spoon.

questions.stem: Why do we use simple machines?
options: To make work easier and faster
questions.explanation: We use simple machines to make work easier and faster.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think machines make work harder.

questions.stem: Which of these is a simple machine used for sweeping?
hints: You use it to clean the floor.
questions.explanation: A broom is a simple machine used for sweeping.
questions.misconception: Pupils may not think a broom is a machine.

questions.stem: Ama wants to cut a piece of paper. Which simple machine should she use?
questions.explanation: Scissors are used for cutting paper.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think a hammer can cut paper.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT a simple machine?
hints: Which one is a large vehicle?
questions.explanation: A car is a complex machine with an engine, not a simple machine.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think all machines are simple machines.

questions.stem: Kwame wants to remove a nail from a piece of wood. Which simple machine should he use?
questions.explanation: A claw hammer is used to remove nails from wood.
questions.misconception: Pupils may choose a tool that cannot grip the nail.

questions.stem: How does a wheelbarrow make work easier?
options: It helps carry heavy loads with less effort
hints: You put heavy things in it.
questions.explanation: A wheelbarrow makes work easier by helping you carry heavy loads with less effort.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think a wheelbarrow is just for playing.

questions.stem: Which simple machine is used to cut cloth?
questions.explanation: Scissors are used for cutting cloth.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think a hammer is for cutting.

questions.stem: A farmer wants to pull water from a deep well. Which simple machine can help him?
hints: It has a wheel and a rope.
questions.explanation: A pulley is a simple machine that helps lift water from a well.
questions.misconception: Pupils may not know what a pulley is.

questions.stem: What is a safe way to use scissors?
options: Point the blades at your friend
Use them carefully and do not run with them
questions.explanation: You should use scissors carefully and never run with them to avoid getting hurt.
questions.misconception: Pupils may not realize scissors are dangerous if misused.

questions.stem: Kofi is trying to open a bottle of soft drink but his hands are slippery. What should he use?
hints: It is specially made for this.
questions.explanation: A bottle opener is the correct simple machine for opening a bottle.
questions.misconception: Pupils may try to use improvised tools that are unsafe.

questions.stem: Which of these is a simple machine used for lifting water from a well?
hints: It uses a rope and a wheel.
questions.explanation: A pulley is used for lifting water from a well.
questions.misconception: Pupils may confuse a pulley with a wheelbarrow.

questions.stem: Why are simple machines important in our daily lives?
options: They help us do work faster and with less effort
They use a lot of electricity
questions.explanation: Simple machines are important because they help us do work faster and with less effort.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think machines are only for factories.

questions.stem: Ama wants to open a tin of tomatoes. Which simple machine should she use?
hints: It is designed to cut metal.
questions.explanation: A tin cutter is a simple machine used to open tins.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think they can open a tin with a spoon.

questions.stem: Why should you not put your fingers near the blades of scissors?
options: They are sharp and can cut you
questions.explanation: You should keep your fingers away from the blades because they are sharp and can cut you.
questions.misconception: Pupils may not recognize the danger of sharp tools.

questions.stem: A student says 'A simple machine makes work easier.' What does this mean?
options: It helps you do a job with less effort
It does the job for you without you doing anything
It makes the job take more time
hints: Think about carrying a heavy load.
Does it help you or make it harder?
questions.explanation: A simple machine makes work easier by helping you do a job with less effort, though you still have to use some force.
questions.misconception: Pupils may think a simple machine works completely on its own.

questions.stem: Draw a bottle opener and label it.
questions.explanation: This tests identifying and drawing a simple machine.

questions.stem: Draw a pair of scissors. Show what they are used for.

criteria.description: Draws a recognisable pair of scissors
Shows or indicates they are used for cutting (e.g., cutting paper)

hints: Draw the blades and the handles.
What do you cut with them?
questions.explanation: This tests identifying and drawing a simple machine and its use.
